desc: Exacting construction and rigorous durability are the standard for every weapon system that comes off the line at BCM. BCM Professional Grade Weaponry are hard use tools, built to perform in combat where unfailing performance is the only standard for men and machine. This Recce-14 comes equipped with a 10" MCMR free floating M-LOK handguard, a BCM Gunfighter charging handle, BCM Mod 1 compensator and BCM pistolgrip/buttstock. The Enhanced Lightweight barrel is 14.5" long with a pinned muzzle device to bring it to a legal 16".
